name: gizza-ai/graph-algorithms
summary: Run BFS, DFS, shortest path, topological sort, and cycle detection on a user-supplied graph.

tool.description: Run a classic graph algorithm on a user-supplied edge list. Provide `edges` (one edge per line, e.g. `a -> b`, `a - b`, `a,b`, or weighted `a -> b : 3`), choose `algorithm` = bfs | dfs | shortest-path | topological-sort | cycle-detection, and set `directed`/`weighted` as needed. bfs/dfs/shortest-path need a `start` node; shortest-path also needs `end`. Returns a human-readable report (visit order, shortest path + distance, topological order, or an example cycle).

edges.description: The graph as an edge list, one edge per line.

weighted.description: Parse a trailing number on each edge as its weight.

start.description: Start node for bfs, dfs, and shortest-path.
